description: This file defines the AOS_Products class for SuiteCRM, extending AOS_Products_sugar, with methods for GUID generation, saving product data including image upload handling, and querying purchased products.

classes.name: AOS_Products
classes.description: Custom class for AOS_Products, extending the base sugar class, with methods for GUID generation, saving with image upload, and retrieving purchased products query.

methods.name: getGUID
methods.description: Generates a GUID using either the Windows function or a custom method.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles product save operation, including image upload validation and processing, and calls perform_aos_save before invoking parent save.

methods.name: getCustomersPurchasedProductsQuery
methods.description: Returns an SQL query to retrieve products purchased by customers, joining quotes, accounts, and related tables.
